792964.name: Chabad Prospect Heights East
792964.note: COL (on CrownHeights.info, 5 May 2005, 'New Shluchim to Prospect Heights'): 'Rabbi Aharon Yosef Kirshenbaum from Crown Heights will be leaving to Prospect Heights for shlichus ... These new shluchim, sent by Tsach, will establish a Chabad House there.' (The listing names Rabbi Ari Kirschenbaum.) Medium: a report of the plan only; the listing went up in Dec 2008, under Rabbi Ari Kirschenbaum (Nov 9 audit).

117905.name: Chabad Lubavitch of Midtown Manhattan
117905.note: COL (on CrownHeights.info, 23 June 2006): a dinner gala 'celebrating the 10th anniversary of Chabad Lubavitch of Midtown Manhattan', Rabbi Yehoshua and Brocha Metzger, 'Shluchim to Midtown' (so 1996). Medium: a count back. Now 509 Fifth Avenue; it also carries on the Radio City Synagogue's older tradition.

118566.name: Chabad Center for Jewish Life
118566.note: Shmais (on CrownHeights.info, 17 Aug 2006, 'New Shluchim To Merick New York'): 'Rabbi & Mrs. Shimon Kramer of Kings Park, NY will IYH be moving on Shlichus to Merrick, NY where they will open a Chabad center to serve the Merrick, Bellmore and Wantagh communities'. The Long Island Herald also says they founded it in 2006. Medium: Chabad.org (13 July 2017) says 'The Kramers founded the Chabad center in 2007' (and bought 2174 Hewlett Avenue in December 2011).

416302.name: Chabad of Forest Hills
416302.note: Shmais (on CrownHeights.info, 30 Jan 2007, 'New Shluchim To New York'): 'Rabbi Mordechai and Sara Hecht have moved on Shlichus to Forest Hills, NY where they have established a new Chabad House', appointed by Rabbi Sholem B. Hecht and Rabbi Shraga Zalmanov of Chabad of Queens. Medium: the report is from Jan 2007 and says they had already moved; the listing went up Aug 21 2006. Chabad of the Gardens: its Forest Hills site opened in 2007; in 2009 it took over 82-52 Abingdon Rd., Kew Gardens.

1263753.name: Chabad of South Bay Long Island
1263753.note: The Shluchim Office (on CrownHeights.info, 5 Aug 2010, 'New Shluchim to New York!'): Rabbi Yona and Devorah Leah Edelkopf 'will be opening up a new location: "Chabad of Massapequa" serving the Massapequa and Babylon, NY areas under Rabbis Anchelle Perl and Tuvia Teldon'. Its listing went up Aug 2 2010.

1366529.name: Chabad of Battery Park City
1366529.note: CrownHeights.info (13 Dec 2010, 'New Shluchim to New York!'): 'Rabbi Chaim and his wife Mushka Zaklos of Crown Heights will IYH be moving out on Shlichus to Battery Park City, NY where they will be establishing a Chabad House', appointed by Rabbi Shmaya and Rochel Katz of Chabad of Wall Street. Its listing went up Nov 25 2010.

1684335.name: Chabad @ The Medical Centers
1684335.note: CrownHeights.info (14 June 2012, 'New Shluchim to Long Island'): 'Rabbi Boruch Sholom and Mushkie Wolf have recently been appointed as the Shluchim to North Shore and Long Island Jewish Medical Centers', appointed by Rabbi Tuvia Teldon. Medium: its listing went up Nov 20 2011, half a year before.

1971123.name: Chabad of Forest Hills North
1971123.note: CrownHeights.info (27 Aug 2012, 'New Shluchim to Queens'): 'Rabbi Mendy and Chaya Hecht ... have recently been appointed as the Chabad Shluchim to North Forest Hills ... They will be opening and directing a new Chabad House to serve the north side of Forest Hills.' Its listing went up Sept 24 2012.

4103691.name: Chabad of Manhasset
4103691.note: Its chabad.org listing went up Aug 29 2018, so it existed (at least on paper) by then; CrownHeights.info (7 July 2024, 'New Shluchim To Manhasset, Long Island'): Rabbi Levi and Shani Paltiel 'are moving down there' to open it (they found 'over 150 Jewish families living in town'). Who ran it from 2018 is not found (the Paltiels of Port Washington next door are the likely link).
